description: The agents of the sidebar as cards: the Gentle Shell flower acts out each status (breathes fast and spins a little sun when working, sleeps with rising z's when idle, pulses and shakes when it needs you, blooms and jumps when done, sways under a falling drop while waiting), with sub-agents, a pin button and a duplicate button.

settings.label: Needs you first
settings.hint: Put the agents that need you at the top of the list. The other agents go to the bottom of the panel, under a line. The bell button in the panel header does the same.
